etsy.title: Aspect Ratio Poster, YouTube Reels & Cinema Format Print, Filmmaker Gift, Video Editor Wall Art
etsy.description:
An aspect ratio poster for the three formats every creator knows: 16:9 for YouTube, 9:16 for Reels, 2.35:1 for Cinema, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in and 8×10 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, editing suite, or creative studio.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy aspect ratio results are mostly wall-art size guides and frame-size charts for sellers, not cinema format posters for buyers.
Filmmaker posters on Etsy lean heavily on patent-style vintage camera prints and cinema knowledge infographics; a dark-mode format joke is distinct.
A Film Formats poster with technical diagrams including aspect ratio charts is listed around $34.95; a Cinematography Knowledge poster is $25.79 on sale.
Video editor posters are mostly dictionary-style definition prints and Premiere Pro cheat sheets as digital downloads.
Amazon filmmaker gifts are dominated by patent-art prints of film reels, projectors, and cameras in blueprint style.
A Film Shot Size Chart canvas poster targets directors and cinematographers; no aspect-ratio-specific poster was found.
Amazon titles stack 'gift', 'wall art', 'home theater', and 'decor' as audience words.

research.notes: 'aspect ratio poster' chosen because Etsy indexes both 'poster_aspect_ratio' and 'aspect_ratio_chart' as market phrases, and no poster specifically about video aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 2.35:1) was found on either platform. The niche gap is clear: existing results are size guides for sellers or cinema patent prints. YouTube and Reels are named because they appear on the printed artwork. No priceRange: the one comparable physical poster ($34.95 Film Formats) is a different product type.
